params.body:
A newsletter is read by very different people: donors in Belgium, technical readers in The Gambia, schools and partners, funds that weigh a request. Starting from an empty page, an edition easily speaks to only one of them. This adds two outlines to start from, one for each newsletter, with a part for each reader.

**On /mailings**

"Start a new one" gets a choice: an empty page (as before, and the default), the KUBO outline or the Afrodidact outline. All three languages are filled in.

**The outlines**

| | KUBO | Afrodidact |
|---|---|---|
| Opening | Dag {voornaam}, and one or two sentences on what happened | the same |
| Story, with a photo | Uit de labs: a school or a community | Uit de klas: a school or a class |
| How it works | Onder de motorkap: one piece of technology, without jargon, with a link for more | KUBO in het kort: two or three sentences with a link to the news on kubo.global |
| Result | Wat het opleverde: a number or a step forward | the same |
| Join in | Doe mee: support, help out, bring in a school; button Steun KUBO to kubo.global/impact | Doe mee: support, help out, forward; button Steun Afrodidact to afrodidact.org/support-us |

French and English follow the same lines, with {prénom} and {first name}, and buttons to the pages in that language.

**Hints cannot go out by accident**

The hints to replace stand in [square brackets]. The editor's list of what is left to do now names every block that still has one. A link written as [words](address) is not a hint and is not flagged.

**Checked**

- `npm test`: 126 tests, among them the outlines (same parts in each language, the right buttons, an empty start stays empty), the warning for a hint left and not for a link, and the mail they give.
- `npm run build`.
- In Chromium with a stand-in for Sanity: starting empty, from the KUBO outline and from the Afrodidact outline; eleven blocks, the list of what is left to do, the parts in the preview, no script errors. The earlier editor walk-through (15 steps) still passes.

Not checked in Safari or Firefox.
params.title: A new newsletter can start from an outline for KUBO or for Afrodidact
